header.title: Muse UFO-B
header.description: Executable source-derived UFO-B event, participation, temporal, manifestation, change and causation package.

definition.text: An event part representing the participation of a agent participant in an event.
A event representing the occurrence of atomic event in UFO-B.
A situation representing a state of affairs in which causal conditions obtain.
A specialization of participation used to represent change in UFO-B.
A event representing the occurrence of complex event in UFO-B.
A specialization of participation used to represent creation in UFO-B.
A specialization of perdurant used to represent event in UFO-B.
A temporally located occurrence of an event within the histories represented by UFO-B.
A type whose instances are event entities as characterized in UFO-B.
A specialization of externally dependent mode used to represent historical dependence in UFO-B.
An event part representing the participation of a object participant in an event.
A specialization of event used to represent participation in UFO-B.
A situation representing a state of affairs in which result conditions obtain.
A specialization of endurant used to represent situation in UFO-B.
notes: UFO-B treats situations as endurants; the A package deliberately does not close Endurant into Substantial/Moment.

definition.text: A type whose instances are situation entities as characterized in UFO-B.
A specialization of complex event used to represent state transition in UFO-B.
A specialization of participation used to represent termination in UFO-B.
A specialization of temporal instant used to represent time point in UFO-B.
A situation representing a state of affairs in which trigger conditions obtain.
A specialization of participation used to represent usage in UFO-B.
